decisions.reason: As a newly launched supplement range with its own page and clear fit with the firm's consumer-health expansion, it is likely to be supported rather than withdrawn.
This skin and hair supplement was actively launched through pharmacies and fits the firm's established OTC and dietary supplement positioning, so it is likely to be retained.
The joint-health supplement supports portfolio broadening in consumer health, though its lower prominence suggests a somewhat higher review risk than the main supplement lines.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is more niche and less prominently marketed, but it still aligns with the firm's strategy of broadening its health-product portfolio.
Given the 2018 safety-related valsartan issue and the product's weaker fit with the firm's established offer, management would be relatively likely to discontinue it and reallocate resources.
